  question: "Which layout for the status file?". Three options. Option 1 label
  "Twelve rows", description "Long.", preview = twelve lines "row 01: alpha"
  through "row 12: alpha" (row NN with two digits, one per line). Option 2
  label "Indented", description "Spacing.", preview = three lines: "fn main()
  {", "    println!(\"hi\");", "}". Option 3 label "No preview here",
  description "Has no preview.", and NO preview field at all. Do nothing else.
